component.name: ibisOffice
component.summary: Create and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents
Word・Excel・PowerPoint の文書を作成・編集します

description.p: ibisOffice is an office suite for Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents. A document made in Microsoft Office should look the same when you open it here: line breaks, page breaks, table borders, even chart tick marks are all built to produce the same result as Office.

ul.li: Open, edit and save .docx, .xlsx and .pptx documents.
Word, Excel and PowerPoint editing, with the toolbars, panels and menus of each.
Export a document as a PDF.
Spell checking, colour palettes, comments and shape effects.

description.p: See the CHANGELOG.md in the source tree.
